title: Identification of disease-associated genes and modifier causing kidney diseases and urinary tract malformations
summary: In recent years, the understanding of hereditary diseases of the kidneys and urinary tract has increased rapidly. Many of these cases occur in childhood or adolescence. However, some observations suggest that a hereditary cause is also present in a relevant number of adult patients. Knowledge of the molecular genetic cause can be decisive for treatment. In addition, the recurrence of the disease in the kidney transplant can influence the planning of a kidney transplant and the selection of a donor. The aim of this study is to identify the frequency and exact molecular genetic cause of pediatric, adolescent and adult patients with Alport spectrum disorder, CAKUT or FSGS/SRNS using exome/genome sequencing.
conditions: Other specified congenital malformation syndromes, not elsewhere classified
